articles.author: Alex Wickham
articles.title: Burnham Plans US Trip Next Month to Lobby Trump on Ukraine Needs - Bloomberg
articles.description: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he and other European leaders plan to travel to the US next month to lobby President Donald Trump to let Ukraine access some of its Patriot air defense missile stocks ahead of the winter.
